facts.business: The Company is primarily engaged in the activities of Real Estate development.

capacity_or_capex.item: Machinery for Dust suppression, Mist Machines and air quality monitoring equipment

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company aims to achieve a 5x growth trajectory through unlocking of its land bank development potential and through low-capex acquisitions.

facts.related_party_note: All contracts, arrangements, and transactions entered into by the Company with related parties during the year under review were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. During the year under review, the Company did not enter into any material related party transactions falling within the scope of Section 188(1) of the Act.
